input.title: Trim whitespace from currency codes before validation
input.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

The error message for invalid currency codes currently reads `"{value}" is not a currency code`. However, the issue arises because the ERP export pads the currency column with a leading space (e.g., ` USD`). The validation logic should trim whitespace from the currency code before checking its validity. This change does not fix the underlying logic but ensures the error message accurately reflects the problematic value, which will help users understand the issue and apply the correct fix (e.g., stripping spaces in their spreadsheet).
